newsitem.title: CHINA: China to slow down Beijing's rapid expansion.
newsitem.headline: China to slow down Beijing's rapid expansion.

text.p: Chinese authorities have decided to slow rapid expansion of Beijing, one of the most crowded and polluted cities in the world, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Land used for new construction projects would be "restricted and tightly managed" by the year 2000, Xinhua quoted State Councillor Luo Gan as telling a committee overseeing the planning and construction of China's capital.
Municipal departments and officials engaged in illegal construction must be investigated and punished, Luo said without elaborating.
Beijing, with a population of more than 12 million, is one of the world's most crowded cities, plagued by traffic jams and pollution.
Luo suggested more experts take part in city planning to build more car parks and green land, Xinhua said.
Easing traffic congestion was high on Beijing's agenda, it said, adding that the city would learn from the experiences of developed countries.
